bandeja.sin_webview2: The editor needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (free from Microsoft). Install it and open the editor again.
bandeja.beta_texto:
You're about to try Luzeira with a {model} on {device}.

This model is in beta: it hasn't been tested with a real display yet.

Luzeira will only send it a greeting first. If it doesn't answer as expected, Luzeira will close the port and let you know, without trying anything else.

Do you want to try it?
bandeja.beta_texto_rev_c:
You're about to try Luzeira with a {model} on {device}.

This model is in beta: it hasn't been tested with a real display yet.

First it has to be woken up: Luzeira opens and closes its port without sending it anything, and this can take about 20 seconds.

Luzeira will only send it a greeting first. If it doesn't answer as expected, Luzeira will close the port and let you know, without trying anything else.

Do you want to try it?
bandeja.beta_texto_sin_saludo:
You're about to try Luzeira with a {model} on {device}.

This model is in beta: it hasn't been tested with a real display yet.

Also, this model doesn't answer any greeting, so Luzeira can't check that it's your display: it will send the image straight away.

If you see stripes or nothing at all, unplug it or choose “Detect it automatically again” (under “Display” in the tray icon menu, or in the editor's “Settings”).

Do you want to try it?
bandeja.se_ve_bien_texto:
Luzeira is sending the theme to the {model} on {device}, but it can't check by itself that it shows up.

Does the theme look right on the display?

If you answer “Yes”, I'll remember it for next time. If you see stripes, odd colors or nothing, answer “No” and I'll stop using it.
bandeja.prueba_rechazada: OK: I won't remember it and I've stopped sending it anything. If the display is left with stripes, unplug it and plug it back in.
bandeja.dialogo_abierto: First answer the Luzeira question you have open.
bandeja.avanzado_texto:
Careful: you're about to send display data to {device} as if it were a {model}, even though Luzeira can't check that it is.

If there's something else on that port (a modem, a Bluetooth adapter, a board…), it will get data it doesn't understand and may act strangely until you unplug it.

Only use this if you know what's connected to that port. Are you sure you want to try?
bandeja.eleccion_guardada: Done: Luzeira will use your {model} on {device}. I'll remember it.
bandeja.deteccion_sola: OK: Luzeira will look for the display by itself.
